review.tagline: OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech server for the Kokoro-82M model
review.summary: Wraps the Kokoro-82M TTS model in a FastAPI server that implements the OpenAI /v1/audio/speech endpoint, with streaming and output in mp3, wav, opus, flac, aac or pcm. It adds weighted voice mixing, inline multi-speaker tags, pause/rate/pronunciation tokens, per-word timestamps and phoneme endpoints. Prebuilt images cover CPU, NVIDIA CUDA and experimental AMD ROCm; Apple Silicon runs natively via uv.
review.audience: Self-hosters who need a local OpenAI-style TTS backend
strengths: Drop-in for the OpenAI speech API; works with the stock OpenAI Python client
Prebuilt CPU and CUDA images for amd64 and arm64 with models baked in
Voice mixing, aliases, inline speaker tags and timestamped captions
Bundled web UI at /web and Swagger docs at /docs
weaknesses: Tied to one model, Kokoro-82M; no other TTS engines
ROCm support is experimental and amd64 only
Apple Silicon GPU (MPS) needs a native uv run, not Docker
Voice tuning from a reference clip is off by default, English only, and approximate
needs: Needs Docker or uv, espeak-ng (direct run, fallback)
